daee-epistemics pipeline

A repo-grounded architecture view: atomized source compiles into the canonical compact DSL-governed runtime; surface discourse is read as a manifestation of operative noetic structure; the framework is designed for every possible live noetic-structure selection before the chosen route is known; meta-noetic memetic dynamics become actionable through DSL/IR control state, owner/TTP activation, burden landing, state re-read, and restorative release. This is repo-native runtime notation, not generic linear algebra and not Shannon.

canonical atomics noetic diagnosis DSL/IR control state selection-space coverage gated governance restorative release

Atomic source / compiled runtime

Atomics are the tracked canonical source files under atomics/skill/. They are not just small files; each carries an operative contract or owner surface. The ignored generated runtime under skill/ is compiled from them by local/CI build, release .skill packages generated runtime, and raw atomics are not packaged. Runtime bundle availability is not activation, and direct invocation must not require extra prompt engineering to recover the owner/TTP floor.

Invariant: original module IDs remain the operative identities. Omnibus filenames are containers, not matched modules.

!Gate before rebuttal

Direct content release before diagnosis is an architecture failure. The visible proposition may be downstream of a noetic blocker.

2Noetic / Meta-Noetic Read

Proper-functional noetic structure

  • Ffiṭrah / faculty orientation: sound, impaired, blocked, or underdetermined
  • Eepistemic environment: whether faculties operate under fitting conditions
  • Rreason role: sound reason, reason-as-tribunal, pseudo-neutral, inherited
  • Ttestimony posture: trusted, demoted, flattened, suspicious, held
  • Ødefeaters / deformation: what prevents proper recognition or assent
Correction: noetic structure is the operative cognitive ecology by which assent is formed, resisted, or stabilized. It is not itself a warrant-conferring argument graph.

Meta-noetic memetics as object-domain

Tracks how the noetic structure and its governing epistemic rules stabilize, defend, mutate, reproduce, and instantiate through language, slogans, labels, institutions, identity pressure, and social habits.

  • mmemetic node / recurring claim-shape
  • τcriterion transfer or imported tribunal
  • LBload-bearing node that regenerates downstream claims
  • CRcollapse radius: what must be re-evaluated if the node clears
Operational boundary: meta-noetic memetics does not create a new routing pass. It becomes real only when encoded into IR fields, suppression, held material, owner/TTP choice, collapse radius, or state re-read.

Design-space invariant

The framework is engineered before the selected noetic structure is known. Each owner family must be able to operate for any possible live first-order, second-order, or higher-order noetic structure; runtime selection then releases the current burden, clears or holds inactive owners, and re-reads state.

4Burden Cycle / Release

Burden cycle

ⁿB → {ⁿBᵢ[OPᵢ]}
→ Land(ⁿB)
→ ΔⁿB / Δκ
→ ∇·T / ∇×T field diagnostics
→ LOOP-BREAKING SUBMOVE
→ R(H,Δ)
→ 𝒞(Ψᴺ) CLOSURE-FIELD CONDITION

Submoves are not burden-cycles. ΔⁿB / Delta-nB and Δκ / Delta-kappa are event-local transition operators computed at burden landing; ∇·T and ∇×T are target-explicit post-Delta field diagnostics; nonzero ∇×T requires HOLD/RECURSE/PARTIAL or a licensed LoopBreak(∇×T); a new ⁿ⁺¹B is licensed only after burden landing, field-state read, and state re-read.

NLA reconstruction fidelity

NLA means Natural Language Autoencoder: a reconstruction-fidelity frame for encoding a natural-language discourse state into a controlled intermediate representation and reconstructing it while preserving burdens, registers, source-status, and dependency structure. AV / activation verbalizer maps to Layer A / Diagnostic IR / noetic-field banner; AR / activation reconstructor maps to reconstruction/reread through R(H,Δ). Reconstruction fidelity gates closure: the verbalized diagnosis must recover selected/held N, live registers, burdens, owner/TTP eligibility, κ/H, and closure state. Confabulation, excessive expressivity, lack of grounding, degenerate bottleneck, or reconstruction failure forces PARTIAL/RECURSE or checker failure.

Delta versus field diagnostics

ΔⁿB / Delta-nB and Δκ / Delta-kappa are event-local transition operators. ∇·T and ∇×T are target-explicit field diagnostics over Δ-produced burden/dependency state. Default output may use compact governance markers such as ∇·κ: positive/live or ∇×κ: unresolved loop only when tied to dependency pressure, loop-breaking, R(H,Δ), or PARTIAL/RECURSE/COMPLETE; long formalism exposition remains audit/formalism-only. Plain ∇ is route-gradient pressure, not generic linear algebra and not Shannon; 𝒞(Ψᴺ) is the closure-field condition; T_lang: Ψᴺ ⇢ Ψᴵ names public output transfer from Ψᴺ toward the diagnosed interlocutor field Ψᴵ without uptake claims.

Package boundary

atomics/skill/** is tracked canonical source. skill/** is ignored generated runtime. Local/CI build compiles atomics into generated skill/**, release .skill packages generated runtime, and raw atomics are not packaged.

Layer A / Layer B surface

  • ALayer A: compact DSL/IR header, not full Diagnostic IR, not full Case State, not load ledger.
  • BLayer B: bounded governed response: Hidden Premises, Core Formulation, operative submoves, compact TTP trace if a named operator works.
  • RState/noetic re-read: what cleared, what remains live, held routes rechecked, next bounded pass or closure reason.

Optional repo/dev route-check harness

  • DDeveloper/CI validation only; not canonical runtime.
  • RCan check route/state artifacts when explicitly run by maintainers.
  • Pdata/, scripts/, tests/, fixtures, route plans, and execution verdicts are excluded from the canonical package.
  • UUser-facing invocation remains /daee-epistemics [case].

Failure modes the design blocks

  • ×retrospective IR after the answer
  • ×route chain treated as current bounded operator
  • ×bundle co-location treated as activation
  • ×held route leaked into Layer B
  • ×first strong argument treated as STOP
  • ×meta-noetic vocabulary without control-surface consequence
